notes: Sourced from the manufacturer's official datasheet (accessed via Wayback Machine archive dated 2024-05-09, since uniguest.com is Cloudflare-protected and blocks direct automated fetches — same file, same URL). This is a compact fanless 4K digital signage media player (Onelan NTB series), not sold through general AV retailers (B&H/Sweetwater/Markertek/Crutchfield do not carry it), so no secondary retailer spec table exists. Datasheet lists connector types (HDMI, DisplayPort, 3.5mm audio, RJ45, USB, RS-232, DC-IN) but does NOT state exact per-port counts for HDMI/DisplayPort (industry convention for this single-output media-player class is 1x each, assumed here) nor HDMI/DisplayPort version numbers, so no 'grade' was set on those two ports (would be a guess). Audio is also embedded over HDMI per the datasheet but that isn't a separate physical port. USB is specified only as an aggregate count (4x USB 2.0 + 2x USB 3.2) with no per-port labels or connector sub-type beyond "USB" — front-panel product photo confirms 2 Type-A ports (blue = USB 3.x) plus 3.5mm mic and headphone jacks, but a rear-panel photo (where HDMI/DisplayPort/Ethernet/RS-232/power would be) is not included in the datasheet, so exact port placement/labeling could not be visually confirmed. Ethernet grade eth-1g is confirmed explicit ("10/100/1000Base-T"). Dimensions 189.6 x 148.3 x 26 mm — small desktop/behind-screen mount unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Optional internal M.2 Wi-Fi card is not a physical port and was omitted. Model variants exist (NTB-4K-10-S, -S-W, -0, -0-W; also a distinct NTB-4K-10F fanned variant with its own datasheet) — this entry covers the base NTB-4K-10 hardware I/O common to all license variants.
